claim: The GPL PC host preserves Xbox info_textureseparator entities as explicit activation no-ops, and all 61 solo/co-op map segments pass a minimized direct-host regression with no failed spawn, error or fatal line.

semantics.xbox_contract: Touch a vis portal and block or unblock texture streaming through it for the local co-op client; the type spawnarg selects close or open.
semantics.pc_translation: Register idTextureSeparatorEntity, preserve entity names and target topology, bind EV_Activate, and consume activation as an intentional no-op because the GPL PC renderer exposes no equivalent portal texture-streaming API.
semantics.not_claimed: The no-op does not emulate Xbox texture residency or establish matched-Xbox visual parity.

source.configuration: Dedicated Release Win32, PlatformToolset v145, pre-build event disabled

counterexample.result: Unknown command 'map'; no entity-spawn marker; run interrupted before timeout.
counterexample.resolution: Use spawnServer for the Dedicated Release host.

remaining_boundary: The PC renderer does not reproduce Xbox client-local portal texture-streaming residency policy.
